newsitem.title: USA: UAL's United Air Feb. load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: UAL's United Air Feb. load factor rises.

text.p: UAL Corp's United Airlines said Tuesday its passenger load factor for February rose to 68.4 percent from 66.3 percent a year ago.

"We are pleased with traffic performance for February overall and especially with a gain of more than two points in our system load factor," John Edwardson, president and chief operating officer, said in a statement. "While the threat of a strike at a major competitor was of some benefit to United, the more important message is that our traffic grew nearly four percent in a strong domestic pricing environment."
